name: Gate file import-closure receipt CAS
target: Release gate per-test-file receipt reuse, sweep certificate invalidation, train-to-cut carry, and isolated recheck
inputs: prior receipts for 6,674 measured test files
three appended commits including a changed shared import and a new test
pinned image digest and exact import-closure content hashes
observations: only tests whose import closure changed are remeasured
matching file receipts carry to the cut without overwriting their measured source head
sweep certificate records source commit, image digest, all file keys, and measurement-derived age/dirty thresholds
append compares the new key set, then runs the dirty set and interference neighbors once at sweep concurrency
image change, dirty-ratio overflow, or certificate age forces a full sweep
removed tests invalidate old keys without being scheduled for execution; a successful supplemental run refreshes the certificate
missing closure hashes and image changes fail closed
the real isolated release-sim-rig graph replays c159bb8d and 1475eed8 through its production gate seam; injected supplemental failure prevents certificate refresh
